title: Settings
subtitle: Control your learning identity, language preferences, and security parameters.
identityDescription: Management of your visual and textual presence across the EduSpace ecosystem.
emailDescription: All administrative notifications and security alerts are dispatched to this address.
languageDescription: Choose the display language for your dashboard, navigation, and coursework.
interfaceLanguageDescription: Choose between English, తెలుగు (Telugu), and हिन्दी (Hindi).
hideDashboardHeaderDescription: Remove the top navigation bar from your dashboard interface.
transparencyDescription: Understanding how your learning metrics and behavioral data are governed.
metricSovereigntyDescription: EduSpace adheres to strict data minimization principles. Your academic performance data is used exclusively to generate insights in the AI Coach and is subject to automated clearing every 24 hours for ephemeral interactions.
dangerZoneDescription: Terminal operations regarding your identity and data history.
erasePresenceDescription: Initiating an account deletion is irreversible. This will purge all associated academic metrics, enrollment tokens, and social configurations from our production databases.
bullet2: Revocation of all active course enrollments
bullet3: Complete purging of asynchronous assignment threads
bullet4: Removal from institutional rosters & leaderboard records
finalConfirmationDescription: This action is absolute. To verify your intent, please provide your current account password and type DELETE below.
validationError: Please enter your password and type 'DELETE' to confirm.
